activation_record_requirements.actor_and_timestamp: Must reflect a real, authorised future action; no placeholder activation records.

execution_rules: This file is a plan, not an activation instruction.
Never insert staged quests without corresponding authorised activation.
Never infer authorisation from successful tests.
Stop and diagnose a failed validation before proceeding.
No deployment, Git push or database migration is authorised.
mandatory_pre_activation_preparation: Preserve the original staging manifest as a historical, inactive snapshot.
Resolve the staging-only loader lifecycle before changing any review record. It currently requires the original review-file fingerprint and all twelve staged quests to remain inactive.
Replace or adapt staging-loader regression tests without weakening exceptional-condition checks.
Identify and update only genuine baseline-count assertions; numeric literals such as 20 may represent skill requirements rather than inactive-review counts.
Preserve mandatory skill, boostability, prerequisite and non-skill-condition requirements.
Demonstrate each proposed catalogue/review state in memory using the existing review validator.
Obtain explicit user authorisation separately before each execution phase.
mandatory_validation_for_each_phase: Existing validator must pass every review.
All OSRS regression tests must pass.
Synthetic activation must pass before any real change.
Catalogue and review counts must match the phase.
All direct and inherited exceptional conditions must remain valid.
Staging and source provenance must remain auditable.
No unrelated requirements or review statuses may change.

ordered_phases.name: Add and activate ten first-layer staged quests
Add and activate two dependent staged quests
